name: Geerling llama.cpp CUDA on rtx2080ti (pc host): llama-2-13b Q4_K_M pp512 1565.08 tok/s
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Jeff Geerling, geerlingguy/ai-benchmarks). llama.cpp build f9ec8858e (7474), backend CUDA, -fa 1 -mmp 0 -ngl 99 (flash attention on, mmap off). Host: Intel Core Ultra 265K, 64GB DDR5, Ubuntu 25.10. Model file size 7.33 GiB, 13.02 B params, Q4_K_M. prefill tok/s, prompt length 512, per-request, batch 1. NOT aggregate. Whole-system wall power during the run 325.3 W (node scope, not device).
notes: Source issue prints the llama-bench mean and the +/- spread; the stored value is the mean. The Pi-host rows are the same physical GPU on a PCIe-constrained host, so they are not a card ceiling.
